title: Projection tests fail for three centred Gaussian components
description: Unrefereed analytic counterexample: one centred planar Gaussian is below a mixture of three centred Gaussians in every projected convex order but not in multivariate convex order. Exact rational covariances and a six-affine-function witness give a strict expectation gap. A specified common-noise perturbation makes every covariance positive definite. Internal exact checks and uncertified quadrature corroborate the written proof; no formal verification, external peer review or absolute priority is claimed. Comparison with Jourdain–Pagès is to arXiv v1, not the unavailable final journal body.
